components.name: AreaChart
components.doc: An area chart for a value over time.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of rows, one per point on the x-axis.

props.name: index
props.doc: Row field for the x-axis. Defaults to "label".

props.name: categories
props.doc: Row fields to plot as series, e.g. ["income","expenses"].

props.name: config
props.doc: Per-series display overrides, e.g. { income: { label: "Income" } }.

props.name: format
props.doc: Names a number formatter. inr = ₹1,23,456 · inrShort = ₹1.2L · percent · number · duration (from minutes).

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 220.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Defaults to true; turn off for a single series.

components.name: Badge
components.doc: A compact status pill.

props.name: text
props.doc: Short label. Badges are for status and tags, never for sentences.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Semantic colour: brand | neutral | success | warning. Defaults to neutral. Bindable, so a row can colour its own badge from the data.

components.name: Bar
components.doc: A single inline progress bar. For a set of categories prefer BarChart.

props.name: value
props.doc: Percentage filled, 0-100.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Fill colour: brand | neutral | success | warning. Use warning when a limit is exceeded. Bindable, so a row can colour its own bar from the data.

props.name: label
props.doc: Caption above the track.

components.name: BarChart
components.doc: A bar chart comparing categories.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of rows, one per point on the x-axis.

props.name: index
props.doc: Row field for the x-axis. Defaults to "label".

props.name: categories
props.doc: Row fields to plot as series, e.g. ["income","expenses"].

props.name: config
props.doc: Per-series display overrides, e.g. { income: { label: "Income" } }.

props.name: format
props.doc: Names a number formatter. inr = ₹1,23,456 · inrShort = ₹1.2L · percent · number · duration (from minutes).

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 220.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Defaults to true; turn off for a single series.

components.name: Button
components.doc: A button. The only way a generated layout sends anything back to the server.

props.name: child
props.doc: Component id of the label, normally a Text.

props.name: variant
props.doc: primary is the one real commit action on a screen; outline (the default) is everything else.

props.name: action
props.doc: { event: { name, context } } dispatched on click.

props.name: checks
props.doc: Validation rules; the button disables and explains itself while any fail.

components.name: Card
components.doc: The outermost surface. Every generated layout starts with exactly one Card whose id is "root".

props.name: child
props.doc: The single root child, almost always a Column.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional card header title.

props.name: description
props.doc: Optional sub-line under the title.

components.name: CheckBox
components.doc: A single boolean toggle.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text beside the box.

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute data-model path this toggle reads and writes.

components.name: ChoicePicker
components.doc: A one-of-N picker rendered as a segmented control.

props.name: label
props.doc: What is being chosen.

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute data-model path this picker reads and writes.

props.name: options
props.doc: Array of choices.

components.name: Column
components.doc: A vertical stack. The default container inside a Card.

props.name: children
props.doc: Child component ids, or { componentId, path } to template one child per row of an array.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Pixels between children.

props.name: align
props.doc: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: justify
props.doc: Main-axis distribution.

props.name: wrap
props.doc: Let children flow onto more than one line.

props.name: weight
props.doc: Flex grow inside a parent Row/Column.

props.name: panel
props.doc: Renders as an inset bordered panel — a section within a card.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Lay children out as an N-column grid instead of a flex line.

components.name: Disclosure
components.doc: Collapsed-by-default content behind a "show more" button.

props.name: label
props.doc: Button text shown while collapsed.

props.name: child
props.doc: Component id revealed when expanded.

components.name: Divider
components.doc: A horizontal rule separating sections inside a card.

components.name: Gauge
components.doc: A radial gauge for a single percentage, e.g. budget utilisation.

props.name: label
props.doc: What is being filled, e.g. "Used".

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 200.

components.name: Icon
components.doc: A monogram avatar (with `label`) or a small named glyph (with `name`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Short text (airline/hotel/person) rendered as a colour-coded monogram avatar.

props.name: name
props.doc: Named glyph, used when `label` is absent.

components.name: Image
components.doc: A photo with built-in loading shimmer and error fallback.

props.name: url
props.doc: Absolute image URL. Falls back to a placeholder when empty or broken.

props.name: fit
props.doc: CSS object-fit. Defaults to cover.

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels, and fills 100% of the available width. Overrides the default thumbnail size — use it for a photo that should read larger, e.g. a profile picture.

components.name: LineChart
components.doc: A line chart for a trend over time.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of rows, one per point on the x-axis.

props.name: index
props.doc: Row field for the x-axis. Defaults to "label".

props.name: categories
props.doc: Row fields to plot as series, e.g. ["income","expenses"].

props.name: config
props.doc: Per-series display overrides, e.g. { income: { label: "Income" } }.

props.name: format
props.doc: Names a number formatter. inr = ₹1,23,456 · inrShort = ₹1.2L · percent · number · duration (from minutes).

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 220.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Defaults to true; turn off for a single series.

components.name: List
components.doc: A repeated collection — bind `children` to `{ componentId, path }` to render one entry per row.

props.name: children
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/ChildList

props.name: layout
props.doc: Defaults to stack.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column count when layout is grid.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: Caps height and scrolls instead of growing.

components.name: Metric
components.doc: A single headline figure with its label — the tile to reach for in a dashboard stat row.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the number measures, e.g. "Monthly income".

props.name: value
props.doc: The number itself. Bind it rather than pre-formatting it.

props.name: delta
props.doc: Optional change line, e.g. "+12% vs last month".

props.name: tone
props.doc: Colours the delta.

props.name: format
props.doc: How to render the value. One of: inr, inrShort, percent, number, duration.

components.name: Pie
components.doc: A donut/pie chart for part-to-whole splits. Best under about 7 slices.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of rows.

props.name: dataKey
props.doc: Row field holding the numeric value. Defaults to "value".

props.name: nameKey
props.doc: Row field holding the slice label. Defaults to "label".

props.name: donut
props.doc: Ring rather than solid pie. Defaults to true.

props.name: format
props.doc: Names a number formatter. inr = ₹1,23,456 · inrShort = ₹1.2L · percent · number · duration (from minutes).

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 220.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Defaults to true.

components.name: RadarChart
components.doc: A radar chart comparing several axes at once.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of rows, one per point on the x-axis.

props.name: index
props.doc: Row field for the x-axis. Defaults to "label".

props.name: categories
props.doc: Row fields to plot as series, e.g. ["income","expenses"].

props.name: config
props.doc: Per-series display overrides, e.g. { income: { label: "Income" } }.

props.name: format
props.doc: Names a number formatter. inr = ₹1,23,456 · inrShort = ₹1.2L · percent · number · duration (from minutes).

props.name: height
props.doc: Pixels. Defaults to 220.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Defaults to true; turn off for a single series.

components.name: Row
components.doc: A horizontal group. The default for putting a label and a value on one line.

props.name: children
props.doc: Child component ids, or { componentId, path } to template one child per row of an array.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Pixels between children.

props.name: align
props.doc: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: justify
props.doc: Main-axis distribution.

props.name: wrap
props.doc: Let children flow onto more than one line.

props.name: weight
props.doc: Flex grow inside a parent Row/Column.

props.name: panel
props.doc: Renders as an inset bordered panel — a section within a card.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Lay children out as an N-column grid instead of a flex line.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A range input for a coarse numeric value.

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute data-model path this slider reads and writes.

props.name: min
props.doc: Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.doc: Defaults to 100.

components.name: Stepper
components.doc: A -/+ number stepper. The right control for small counts like travellers or rooms.

props.name: label
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString|Represents a string

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute data-model path this stepper reads and writes.

props.name: min
props.doc: Lower bound. Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.doc: Upper bound. Defaults to 99.

props.name: step
props.doc: Increment per press. Defaults to 1.

components.name: Table
components.doc: A real data table. Prefer it over stacks of Rows whenever the content is genuinely tabular — several records sharing the same fields.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column definitions, left to right.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Array of row objects. Bind this to a data path.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: Tabbed panels. Use only when content genuinely splits into alternatives the user picks between.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: Tab order, left to right.

props.name: panels
props.doc: Map of tab id -> child component id.

props.name: defaultTab
props.doc: Tab id open on first render. Defaults to the first tab.

components.name: Text
components.doc: A run of text. The workhorse — headings, labels, values, captions all use it.

props.name: text
props.doc: The string to render.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Typographic role. h2 titles a card, caption is secondary/muted, mono is for codes and figures.

components.name: TextField
components.doc: A labelled text input bound to the data model.

props.name: label
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString|Represents a string

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute data-model path this field reads and writes.

props.name: inputType
props.doc: Native input type. Defaults to text.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString|Represents a string

props.name: min
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString|Represents a string

props.name: max
props.doc: REF:common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString|Represents a string
